# MentorCruise

> MentorCruise connects mentees with industry experts for personalized mentorship across engineering, product, AI, design, and leadership development.

MentorCruise is a mentorship platform offering 1-on-1 coaching, team training programs, and fractional executive services. The platform serves individuals seeking career guidance, skill development, and career transitions, as well as enterprises looking to develop their teams and leadership.

## Platform Overview

- [MentorCruise - Connecting Mentors & Mentees](https://mentorcruise.com): MentorCruise homepage connecting mentees with industry experts across engineering, product, AI, design.

## Enterprise & Team Solutions

- [Coaching for Teams, Organizations & Enterprise - MentorCruise](https://mentorcruise.com/teams): Enterprise team coaching and mentorship programs for organizational development and leadership.
- [Information for Employers - MentorCruise](https://mentorcruise.com/teams/info): Employer information for team mentorship, professional development, and mentor matching services.

## Executive Services

- [Fractional Executive Service | Expert Executives for Your Business | MentorCruise](https://mentorcruise.com/fractional-executive): Fractional Executive service offering part-time C-suite expertise for startups and SMBs.
